inclusion_rules.APPEARS_IN_CHANNEL: every (Person, Channel) pair one chunk holds through an INVOLVES or MENTIONS edge and an IN_CHANNEL edge
inclusion_rules.APPEARS_IN_PRODUCT: every (Person, Product) pair one chunk holds through an INVOLVES or MENTIONS edge and an IN_PRODUCT edge
inclusion_rules.COLLEAGUE: metadata/salesforce_team.json — every unordered pair of person entries reporting to one entry, for every entry in the tree; one edge per pair, endpoints in sorted id order, `manager` the shared owner's id
inclusion_rules.HAS_CHANNEL: every (Product, Channel) pair one chunk's own product and channel attributes declare together
inclusion_rules.IN_COMPANY: metadata/customers_data.json — every entry's own `company` field; the directory carries the field on every entry, so every entry gets the relation
inclusion_rules.IN_ORG: metadata/employee.json — every entry's own `org` field; the directory carries the field on every entry, so every entry gets the relation
inclusion_rules.MANAGES: metadata/salesforce_team.json — every nesting of a person entry inside another entry's report list, for every entry in the tree; `role` is the source's own list-field name
